children: It was déjà vu all over again for Investore Property in 1H, says Forsyth Barr. Investore's result was broadly in line with expectations but with higher maintenance capex. Portfolio metrics were largely stable and FY27 guidance was unchanged. "Gearing is reducing, with some progress divesting non-core assets, but Investore is not in a rush, given its limited near-term capital commitments and ample time until its convertible notes mature," analyst Rohan Koreman-Smit says. Forsyth Barr's price target eases 0.9%, to NZ$1.14/share, to reflect revised forecasts for additional vacancy and maintenance capex. Investore is up 0.5%. to NZ$1.005. today. (david.winning@wsj.com; @dwinningWSJ)
